challenge.method: Compared Frankfurt’s heading, linked title, grant and source-notice clauses with GovData’s edition documentation. Tested substitution of GovData’s HTML or the neighboring Zero row for the municipal witness, and checked whether the actual Index row assigned historical.
challenge.results: Frankfurt’s heading renders as DL-DE->BY-2.0, and its source-notice list repeats a business-process permission and adds a provider-information qualifier. GovData’s documentation presents the source-notice items differently. The repeated full German title, /dl-de/by-2-0 link and attribution language resolve the edition despite those differences. GovData’s page has a different digest, Zero has a different entity and terms, and the exact Frankfurt row reads active.

limitations: Frankfurt qualifies its default with “Soweit bei den Daten nichts Anderes vermerkt ist” (unless the data indicate otherwise). A particular dataset’s governing terms, redistribution rights and installation eligibility require their own evidence.

The municipal copy contains transcription irregularities. The edition identification is supported, while verbatim equivalence to GovData’s complete legal text and the precise legal effect of the irregular wording remain unverified.
Active records an editorial Index lookup decision. Publisher currency, SPDX deprecation and dataset release authorization are separate determinations.
